mapper.select: select n.node_id, n.space_id, s.space_name, n.parent_id, n.ancestors, n.node_type, n.node_name, n.normalized_name, n.extension, n.content_type, n.size_bytes, n.status, n.active_flag, n.version, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time from drive_operation_log l inner join ( select node_id, max(operation_id) as operation_id from drive_operation_log where operator_user_id = #{userId} and result = 'SUCCESS' and action in ('OPEN', 'PREVIEW', 'DOWNLOAD') and node_id is not null group by node_id ) latest on latest.operation_id = l.operation_id inner join drive_node n on n.node_id = l.node_id and n.status = 'ACTIVE' and n.active_flag = 1 inner join drive_space s on s.space_id = n.space_id and s.status = 'ACTIVE' order by l.operation_id desc limit #{limit}
